slides.title: Employed with a side hustle? Read this
slides.sub: File online by 30 December and HMRC may collect your bill through your payslip.

slides.title: The 30 December rule
body: You already pay tax through PAYE, for example as an employee.
You file your return online by 30 December.
Then the tax can be collected through your tax code.

slides.title: Start this weekend
body: Find your UTR and your HMRC sign-in.
Add up your total sales and your costs.
Open the return and save as you go.

slides.title: The dates that matter
body: 30 Dec: file online to pay through your tax code.
31 Jan 2027: last day to file online.
31 Jan 2027: last day to pay what you owe.
